name: ennyn
description: A Claude Code plugin and Node CLI that gives the agent a working routine: impact analysis before code is written, a two-round review, and checks on every commit for recurring classes of bugs. In every session its hooks record the plugin's version in the plugin's own data folder; everything else they do only in a project with an Ennyn config (.ennyn/config.json, or the file ENNYN_CONFIG names): pass the project's path-scoped rules into worktrees and copies, apply the conversation style you chose, refuse every git push but a plain one the ask rule reads for certain, hold idle compaction while a task is mid-way, and ask every summary to name the task, its files and the next step (`compaction.defer: false` turns both off).
author: Berkay Boran

scripts.test:reference: node test/reference/npm.mjs check && node test/reference/markdown.mjs check && node test/reference/actions-yaml.mjs check && node test/reference/claude.mjs
scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/plugin.json
